title: Polar form as a dot product
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $x,z\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The sum over pairs $i<j$ of $x_i z_j+z_i x_j$ equals the dot product of $x$ with the vector whose $i$th coordinate is the sum of all $z_j$ with $j\ne i$.
